summary: Sidebar keyboard handler supports Left and Right but omits Up and Down for vertical navigation.
detailed_description: Sidebar keyboard handler supports Left and Right but omits Up and Down for vertical navigation.
expected_behavior: Focus and selection advance one row.
recommended_fix: Support vertical arrow keys and expose the orientation.
verification_test: Focus Dashboard, press ArrowDown, expect Apps to be focused and selected.
implementation_note: Focused Home and pressed ArrowDown. Apps received focus at both viewport sizes.

summary: When the notification service is unavailable, launch denial uses a blocking native dialog in the launch handler.
detailed_description: When the notification service is unavailable, launch denial uses a blocking native dialog in the launch handler.
repro_steps: Exercise an adapter denial using a test fixture.
expected_behavior: Denial reason stays in app context.
recommended_fix: Render a persistent inline error and restore focus to Launch.
verification_test: Assert zero dialog events and an accessible denial reason.
implementation_note: Launch failure fallback writes to #apps-launch-status. Verify the denial path with notifications disabled.

summary: Saving settings uses a blocking native alert for success.
detailed_description: Saving settings uses a blocking native alert for success.
repro_steps: In an isolated test profile save a reversible preference.
expected_behavior: Save confirmation permits continued keyboard interaction.
verification_test: Wait for success status and assert no native dialog.
implementation_note: Settings save writes success and failure to #settings-save-status. Exercise a reversible setting in a disposable operator profile.

summary: Sidebar account shortcut is a clickable div without native keyboard activation.
detailed_description: Sidebar account shortcut is a clickable div without native keyboard activation.
repro_steps: Navigate the dashboard shortcuts with Tab
Try activating the sidebar operator card using Enter.
expected_behavior: Keyboard users can open the same profile shortcut.
recommended_fix: Use a button with a visible focus indicator.
verification_test: Locate the shortcut by button role, focus, press Enter and assert profile is visible.
implementation_note: Operator shortcut is a native button. Verify activation using Enter from focus.

summary: Account markup announces ADMIN before the identity service confirms the role. This is a misleading display, with no evidence of a backend privilege grant.
detailed_description: Account markup announces ADMIN before the identity service confirms the role. This is a misleading display, with no evidence of a backend privilege grant.
repro_steps: Inspect initial account HTML before profile hydration.
expected_behavior: Unknown role displays Pending or Unavailable.
recommended_fix: Render a neutral initial badge and enable privileged controls only after confirmation.
verification_test: Delay the identity response and verify no ADMIN badge appears for an unverified operator.
implementation_note: Removed initial and fallback ADMIN role labels from the profile. Verify guest, delayed identity and authorized operator hydration.

summary: Category filters use clickable divs without keyboard semantics.
detailed_description: Category filters use clickable divs without keyboard semantics.
repro_steps: Tab through the catalog filters and try selecting a category.
verification_test: Focus a category by role, press Space and check filtered results.
implementation_note: Focused a category and pressed Space. aria-pressed changed to true at both sizes. Confirm filtering against a populated catalog.

summary: YouTube, Documents, Research and Account failed to display during both viewport passes. Cause under investigation.
detailed_description: The live DOM placed YouTube, Documents and Research inside hidden #tab-developer. The initial live document lacked #tab-account. The later source checkout includes Account. Recheck after pinning the served revision.
repro_steps: Click the named sidebar button and wait for the matching panel.
expected_behavior: Selected panel becomes visible and usable.
recommended_fix: Inspect panel ancestry and the selected state alongside service health.
verification_test: For every nav button click and expect the matching panel to be visible.
implementation_note: All 23 navigation destinations opened at both viewport sizes from the current shell with isolated backend responses.

summary: Catalog counts in static filter labels disagree with the live grid of 45 Details buttons, including 20 under Available.
detailed_description: Catalog counts in static filter labels disagree with the live grid of 45 Details buttons, including 20 under Available.
repro_steps: Count visible Details buttons with All and Available selected.
expected_behavior: Filter counts match the current catalog.
recommended_fix: Derive counts and search placeholder from manifest data.
verification_test: Assert filter count equals matching grid card count.
implementation_note: Connected Chromium loaded the working tree shell with an intercepted 503 and a three-app MOCK catalog. Retry restored total 3, Available Only (2) displayed two cards and Planned showed 1. Missing catalog displayed a dash. Deployment catalog remains unverified.

summary: Local Ollama conversation route returns provider errors after more than 20 seconds.
detailed_description: Selected ollama:moondream:latest. Two memory prompts ended with explicit provider errors at 22.065 s and 23.130 s. Code generation still pending at 25 s. Model uptime and hardware cause unknown.
repro_steps: Select the local Moondream model in Conversation mode.
Send Remember the audit word violet. Reply with only the word.
Ask What was the audit word?
expected_behavior: A capable available model answers or an unavailable route is identified promptly.
recommended_fix: Verify model readiness and task suitability, expose timeout and cancellation state, and offer an explicitly chosen alternative.
verification_test: Test a warm available route and an unavailable fixture. Check reply content and terminal UI state separately, and record first-token and completion latency.
implementation_note: Focused tests confirm empty installed-model lists are unavailable and explicit model choice is preserved. A rejected model switch now surfaces an error. Live inference latency and recall remain unverified. Chat exposes provider availability and a refresh control. A focused test confirms an unavailable conversation model leaves the draft intact and makes zero requests.

summary: Mounted extension APIs are incorrectly marked unavailable when FastAPI retains nested included routers.
detailed_description: After the authorized core restart, the live catalog returned 45 apps with 25 extension entries in_development; the suite registered 42 modules and all 25 extension UI/health route pairs returned HTTP 200. The catalog inspected only top-level route metadata.
repro_steps: Compare extension states with registered UI and health routes.
expected_behavior: Registered enabled module interfaces can be opened; absent or disabled interfaces remain unavailable. Interface availability does not imply provider or hardware readiness.
recommended_fix: Resolve prefixed included-router metadata without executing handlers or importing module engines.
verification_test: Test nested router prefixes and catch-all exclusion; after authorized deployment confirm registered extension cards can open while missing/disabled entries remain blocked.
implementation_note: Nested-router correction integrated into the current source; five focused bridge tests passed in isolation. Live deployment verification remains pending.
